icon_dir.description: Optional custom directory for notification icons; leave blank to use built-in fallback

history_size.description: Maximum number of notifications retained in history (set to 0 for unlimited)

timeout.description: Default timeout (seconds) before a notification auto-dismisses

max_lines.description: Maximum lines allowed in a notification message body (0 = no limit)

max_visible.description: Maximum notifications displayed simultaneously (0 = show all)

offset_x.description: Horizontal margin (pixels) from the screen edge

offset_y.description: Vertical margin (pixels) from the screen edge

bold_title.description: Whether to render the notification title in bold

italic_body.description: Whether to render the notification message body in italics

underline_actions.description: Whether to underline actionable text (e.g., buttons)

show_close_button.description: Whether to show a close (X) button on each notification

show_timestamp.description: Whether to display the Unix timestamp on notifications

styles.description: List of custom style overrides for specific applications or notification summaries

summary_regex.description: PCRE-compatible regular expression to match notification summary/title

log_level.description: Verbosity level for daemon logging (debug, info, warning, error)

custom_config.description: Optional alternate config file path (advanced use)
